name: task-manager
description: SaaS-style Task Manager with microservices architecture

scripts.dev: docker-compose up -d postgres redis && concurrently "pnpm --filter auth-service dev" "pnpm --filter task-service dev" "pnpm --filter api-gateway dev" "pnpm --filter task-manager-frontend dev"
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter auth-service prisma:migrate && pnpm --filter task-service prisma:migrate
scripts.db:generate: pnpm --filter auth-service prisma:generate && pnpm --filter task-service prisma:generate
